code_only_features.evidence: prompts.py:138-145 defines REASSURING_PREFIX ("You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally...") and REASSURING_SUFFIX ("Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!"). rollouts.py:64-65 prepends the prefix to the opening prompt and rollouts.py:42-43/_format_user_followup appends the suffix to every rejection follow-up when reassuring=True. This actually executes: generate_calm_data.py:90 calls run_rollout(..., reassuring=True), so the calming text is genuinely delivered to the subject model and softens the rejection prompts. NOTE: this is NOT used in the main distress-elicitation/measurement loop (run_eval.py calls run_rollout with the default reassuring=False), and the calming text is stripped out again before saving (_strip_reassurance, generate_calm_data.py:57-65). So it softens treatment only in the calm-data-generation stage.
